# Biological Sequence Location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/BiologicalSequenceLocation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A sequence-level container locus — a chromosome, contig, scaffold, or the sequence itself — that hosts [`SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) annotations via [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md). The features themselves (genes, exons, SNPs, etc.) are [`SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) instances with their own coordinates and types; they are not [`BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) instances.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a sequence-level container locus — a chromosome, contig, scaffold, or the sequence itself — that hosts feature annotations.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the features themselves (genes, exons, SNPs are [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) instances) and for a terrestrial place.

### How to use

- Type as [`BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) and attach features via [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md); the features carry their own coordinates and types.

### Examples

- ex:chr7 a [`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md); [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md) ex:brca1.
